description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of different methods, with the categories listed on the horizontal axis in the order: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune CInGS (w/), and CInGS. The vertical axis is labeled "Average Performance" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each category is represented by a distinct colored bar: orange for Standard, brown for Self-RAG, green for FactTune CInGS (w/), blue for CInGS (w/), and dark blue for CInGS. The bars are not grouped or stacked, and their heights correspond to the average performance values, which are approximately 52.5 for Standard, 54 for Self-RAG, 52 for FactTune CInGS (w/), 53 for CInGS (w/), and 59 for CInGS. The bars are not sorted in a specific order other than the categorical order on the horizontal axis, and none of the bars are visually emphasized.
